event_name: Document 16 Date 18 March 2022 Time 20:24 2022 BAHRAIN GRAND PRIX 18 - 20 March 2022 The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 11 & 12) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Impeding of Car 22 by Car 18 in Turn 8.
offence: Breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Reprimand for the driver This is the driver's 1st Reprimand of the Season (Driving)
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 18 (Lance Stroll), the driver of Car 22 (Yuki Tsunoda) and team representatives, and examined video and team radio evidence. After both cars had taken the chequered flag at the end of the session, car 18 (STR) turned into turn 8 whilst car 22 (TSU) was approaching quickly to the inside, unnecessarily impeding car 22 and causing minor contact. Driver 18 says he was travelling slowly in preparation for a practice start and was looking in his mirrors but the closing speed from cars behind travelling much more quickly meant he did not see car 22 when approaching turn 8. The Stewards acknowledge this, and note that the Team did not give the driver any radio warning of approaching cars, but consider that the driver has responsibility for maintaining awareness of cars around them and that this applies equally on the lap after the chequered flag. The Stewards therefore determine that this is a breach of the above regulation and impose a Reprimand in this case.
rules_referenced: Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
